name: akuity
description: Akuity Platform workflows over MCP: complete or partial onboarding, plus normal, incident, and pre-promotion work delegated to Akuity agents.

interface.longDescription: Connect to the Akuity Platform MCP endpoint, onboard all or part of an Argo CD and Kargo delivery setup, and delegate normal, incident, or promotion-risk work to Akuity agents.
defaultPrompt: Onboard my application onto Akuity using only the parts I need.
Ask the Deployment Agent about this Argo CD or Kargo instance.
Assess a Kargo promotion before I release it.
